usedFor: Appcues creates banners and flows, and Google Sheets keeps the running log that “Add New Row to Sheet” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “When a banner is created” in Appcues, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new banner becomes a row, so the team has one sheet listing what was published.

watchOut: “When a banner is created” in Appcues is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check.
